name: 49316 · Caledonia, MI
findings: ZIP 49316 (Caledonia) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49316 (Caledonia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
